name: jira_sprint_issues_list
description: Returns all issues in a sprint, optionally filtered by status (GET /rest/agile/1.0/sprint/{sprintId}/issue)

sprint_id.description: The ID of the sprint that contains the requested issues, for example 5.

status.description: Filters results to issues currently in this status, for example In Review.

limit.description: The maximum number of issues to return per page. Default: 30.
